title: Colonel Roosevelt’s speech to be delivered at St. Louis, Missouri. Saturday, Feruary 9, 1918
checks: The document calls this a speech to be delivered. It may have been prepared and never given.
Day by Day, which follows the Theodore Roosevelt Association's Chronological Record, places him at Roosevelt Hospital on this date, about 1,410 km from St. Louis. One of the two dates may be wrong.
